description: This file is a JavaScript source code for the jQuery plugin 'jEditable' version 1.7.3. It provides in-place editing capabilities for web page elements, allowing them to be editable via various input types with extensive configuration options.

methods.name: editable
methods.description: Main plugin method that initializes in-place editing on selected elements, supports enabling, disabling, and destruction of the editing functionality.

methods.name: addInputType
methods.description: Adds a new input type to the set of editable types supported by the plugin.
